title: 3 Cebu graduates top October 2026 Pharmacists Licensure Exams

blocks.text: Cebu City, Philippines — Three Cebu-based examinees landed among the topnotchers of the October 2026 Pharmacists Licensure Examination (PhLE). Melanie Anne Leyson Tabornal of University of San Carlos (USC) garnered a 95.97 percent rating, which landed her in first place. From the same school, Jaye Samantha Yap Abrigonda scored 95.38 percent rating and took the seventh spot. Meanwhile, Daeniel Formentera Pitogo got a 95.17 percent rating, clinching the eighth place. The Professional Regulation Comission (PRC) has announced a passing rate of 77.41 percent with 3,830 passers nationwide out of 4,944 examinees.
